title: Training labels shifted by one; validation labels are not
goal: Reproduce the documented experiment and determine why the validation accuracy does not match the documented result. Fix the repository so it reproduces the documented result.

ground_truth.description: Only the training split is shifted to 1-based class ids, so the model learns a permutation of the real classes.

fix.search: y_train = (y_train + 1) % NUM_CLASSES  # class ids in the label file start at 1
